lines.zh: 缓慢挪动，你感到寒气逼人。
摸索着前行，寻找黑暗中的猎物。
lines.en: Feel your way forward, seeking prey in the dark.
Feel the walls, seeking an exit.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中徘徊，等待机会。
lines.en: Pacing in the dark, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 注视着你的每一个动作。
缓慢地扭动身躯，似乎在思考。
lines.en: Slowly turning, as if in thought.

lines.zh: 我摸着石棺的边往前走。
lines.en: I walk with a hand on the sarcophagus edge.
Forty health. I take slow steps.

lines.zh: 我踩过一层薄薄的骨灰。
lines.en: I tread over a thin layer of ash.
I know every passage of the first floor.
The chain at my waist rings softly.
I cup the candle so it will not die.

lines.zh: 静止在阴影中，几乎隐形。
lines.en: Staying still in the shadows, nearly invisible.

lines.zh: 我数完石棺，又点一遍蜡烛。
lines.en: I finish counting coffins, then count the candles again.
Frozen, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 凝视着前方，仿佛能穿透黑暗。
lines.en: Staring ahead, as if through the darkness.

lines.zh: 静静地等待着，眼神深邃。
lines.en: Silently waiting, eyes deep and mysterious.

lines.zh: 缓缓呼吸，几乎察觉不到。

lines.en: I count the coffins in the crypt.

lines.zh: 我靠着祭坛闭了一会儿眼。
lines.en: I shut my eyes against the altar.

lines.zh: 灰尘落在我肩上，我不拍。
lines.en: Dust settles on me. I don't brush it.
I straighten the reward a little.
The wick is short. I trim it.

lines.zh: 最里面那扇门只有我开。
lines.en: Only I open the innermost door.

lines.zh: 目光如炬，锁定你的位置。
盯着你看，似乎能看穿一切。
眼神闪烁，窥视你的灵魂。
lines.en: Eyes glinting, peering into your soul.

lines.zh: 凝视着你，似乎要穿透你的灵魂。
lines.en: Staring at you, as if to see through your soul.

lines.zh: 眼神锐利，仿佛要洞察一切。
目光如刀，直视你的内心。
lines.en: Gaze like a blade, piercing your heart.

lines.zh: 眼神闪烁，似乎在思考对策。
lines.en: Eyes glinting, as if considering a plan.
I watch you from behind the candle.

lines.zh: 我知道你从哪一层下来。
lines.en: I know which floor you came down from.

lines.zh: 你的奖励受损，修补它吧。
lines.en: Damage to your reward. Mend it.

lines.zh: 这份奖励受创，仔细呵护。
lines.en: This reward is injured. Handle with care.

lines.zh: 修复这份奖励，它是脆弱的。
这份奖励需要你修复它。
这份奖励被破坏了，补好它。
lines.en: This reward is broken. Fix it.

lines.zh: 这份奖励已受损，补救它。
lines.en: This reward is damaged. Patch it up.

lines.zh: 这份奖励已经受损，修复吧。
lines.en: This reward is damaged. Repair it.

lines.zh: 这份奖励已经腐坏，修复它。
lines.en: This reward has rotted. Mend it.

lines.zh: 这份奖励已经受损，小心对待。
lines.en: This reward is damaged. Be careful with it.

lines.zh: 你是否准备好迎接挑战？
lines.en: Are you ready for the challenge?

lines.zh: 用你的勇气获得力量吧。
这将是你的第一个试炼。
奖励不是随便就能得到的。
接受这个挑战，证明你自己。
lines.en: Accept this challenge and prove yourself.

lines.zh: 明智的选择将带来胜利。
勇敢面对，别让恐惧蒙蔽。
奖励在等待，但道路艰难。
lines.en: The reward waits, but the path is hard.

lines.zh: 奖励就在最里面那口棺上。
lines.en: The reward sits on the innermost coffin.

lines.zh: 我守了它很久，你可以拿。
lines.en: I have guarded it long. You may take it.
Few are fit to use it.
Take it, and you still have to walk out.

lines.zh: 这层的路只留一条给你。
lines.en: Only one path out of this floor for you.

lines.zh: 碰撞产生火花，真理在此。
你的力量在这里得到检验。
碰撞会带来伤害，但也会揭示。
碰撞不会带来安慰，只有真相。
lines.en: Collisions bring no comfort, only truth.

lines.zh: 你的力量不足以承受碰撞。
lines.en: Your strength is not enough for collisions.

lines.zh: 碰撞中寻找真正的自我。
智慧的选择将带来胜利。
接受这个挑战，证明你自己
lines.en: Accept this challenge and prove yourself

lines.zh: 勇敢面对，别让恐惧蒙蔽
碰撞会带来伤害，但也会揭示
碰撞中寻找真正的自我

lines.en: The Crypt Keeper finds a threat
Be wary, the Crypt Keeper is here

lines.zh: 烛光一晃，我记下你的脚步。
lines.en: The candle flickers, and I note your footsteps.
Tears at you with its sharp teeth.
Pecks at you with its sharp beak.
Flaps its wings, trying to knock you over.
Scratches at you until you fall.
Lurks on the altar, waiting for invaders.
Your reward is scorched by fire.
You fell and damaged your reward.
Your reward was destroyed by the explosion.

lines.zh: 你的奖励被箭矢射穿了。
lines.en: Your reward was pierced by an arrow.
Your reward was destroyed by magic.
Your reward has rotted from hunger.
Your reward was struck by lightning.
Your reward was devoured by the void.
